17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 4614 N. Seeley Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: | RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 1,967.47 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is keeping the existing single-family residence and detached
garage containing two (2) off-street parking spaces. The Applicant plans to
construct a dormer addition to the existing single-family residence. The
single-family residence will measure around 26 ft.-7 4% inches in height.
Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and
Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is to reduce the front setback from the required
4.49” to zero; combined side setback requirement of 10.51’ to zero; north
side setback from 2’ to zero; south side setback from 2’ to zero; rear setback
from 11.23’ to 2’-9”; waive the required rear yard open space of 127.89 SF
to zero and all relicf necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for
the attached plans.
